description: Render an edit file to an MP4 with the local ffmpeg. An edit lists clips in order (video or image, with trims, speed, volume, cut or fade), audio tracks (music, voiceover), timed captions, an end card and a target loudness. Call edit_schema once to see the format. Render with quality draft first, look at it, then final. Returns the MP4 path, duration, size and render time.

baseDir.description: With `edit`: the folder clip paths are relative to. Default: the working directory.

edit.description: Or the edit object itself, instead of a file.

file.description: Path to the edit JSON file. Clip paths inside are relative to this file. Preferred.

out.description: Output .mp4 path. Default: renders/<name>-<quality>.mp4 next to the edit file.

quality.description: draft = fast and small, to check your work; final = full quality.

validateOnly.description: Check the edit and report the timeline without rendering.

name: render_edit
title: Render an edit to MP4
